about: Hand-curated input of scripts/build_lab_codes.py: catalog id → NČLP keys, NČLP key → LOINC (each checked ACTIVE on tx.fhir.org, LOINC 2.82, 2026-10-19), extra Czech synonyms per NČLP component. docs/plans/lab-codes.md.

glukoza.note: B item 01889 linked because labs print B_Glukóza; arterial/capillary/NaF/oGTT plasma variants skipped.

kreatinin.note: NČLP has separate 'Kreatinin enzymaticky' items (08573/08571); both linked, no method-specific SerPl LOINC found so generic 14682-9 used.

egfr.note: Calculated NČLP item (CKD-EPI, creatinine; procedure Výpočet). LOINC: CKD-EPI 2021 and the older CKD-EPI code; LOINC unit mL/min/1.73 m2 vs ml/s/1.73 m2 here (×60).

bilirubin_konjugovany.note: NČLP item is 'conjugated' -> 29760-6; direct bilirubin LOINC would be 14629-0.
bilirubin_konjugovany.ambiguous: Entry mixes conjugated and direct ('přímý') bilirubin, which are different LOINC codes (29760-6 vs 14629-0).

alp_kostni.note: Linked the mass items 'ALP kostní typ (protein)' [µg/l] matching the catalog unit; NČLP also has catalytic (00550/00548, µkat/l) and fraction (00546/00544) items.
alp_kostni.ambiguous: Bone ALP is reported either as mass (µg/l, Ostase) or catalytic activity (µkat/l); these are different NČLP/LOINC codes (17838-4 vs 1777-2).

ldh.note: Generic LDH SerPl 2532-0 is DISCOURAGED; used 14804-9 (lactate-to-pyruvate, the IFCC method used in CZ).

piiinp.note: NČLP 'Propeptid prokolagenu III N-term.', unit µg/l = ng/ml. Only a Serum LOINC exists (71792-6), so no LOINC for the plasma item.

ace.note: NČLP also has 59503 (S; arb. subst. conc. U/l) and ACE mass/arb items, not linked.

amoniak.note: NČLP has only a plasma item (no serum item).

beta_hydroxybutyrat.note: No whole-blood item in NČLP (B_ synonym exists; Bld LOINC would be 104816-4).

bilirubin_nekonjugovany.note: No unconjugated/indirect bilirubin item in NČLP (usually computed total minus conjugated). LOINC would be 14630-8.

homa_ir.note: Calculated NČLP item "HOMA - IR" (S; index); no LOINC found.

laktat.note: P and B items linked (no serum item in NČLP); arterial/venous/capillary variants skipped.

lipoprotein_a.note: Molar items linked (catalog nmol/l); NČLP also has mass items 02388/02386 [g/l].
lipoprotein_a.ambiguous: Lp(a) is reported either in nmol/l or as mass (g/l, mg/dl) with no fixed conversion; these are different NČLP/LOINC codes.

kortizol.note: Generic cortisol linked; 'ranní/8:00' synonyms are the same analyte (no timed LOINC used).

testosteron_volny.note: Some labs print calculated free testosterone (LOINC 96559-0 by calculation); generic 14914-6 used.

fai.note: Calculated NČLP item "Index volného testosteronu" (Vzorec 1), unit [1] vs catalog %.

acth.note: NČLP has only plasma items: mass (03181, ng/l) and molar (14438, pmol/l; fixed conversion via catalog factor 4.541).
acth.ambiguous: ACTH is reported in ng/l (mass) or pmol/l (molar), different NČLP/LOINC codes.

aldosteron.note: NČLP unit nmol/l vs catalog pmol/l (fixed factor 1000).

amh.note: NČLP only has mass items [µg/l] (catalog pmol/l, conversion 7.14); molar LOINC would be 48377-6.
amh.ambiguous: AMH is reported as mass (µg/l) or molar (pmol/l) concentration, which are different LOINC codes (38476-8 vs 48377-6).

gastrin.note: NČLP also has arbitrary-unit items 55296/55294 [mU/l], not linked.

hcg.note: Total hCG (02015/02011) and beta subunit (02024/02022) both linked.
hcg.ambiguous: Entry mixes total hCG and beta-hCG, which are different NČLP/LOINC codes.

metanefrin.note: NČLP unit nmol/l vs catalog pmol/l (factor 1000). Plasma metanephrines are free fractions -> 'Metanephrine Free' LOINC.

normetanefrin.note: NČLP unit nmol/l vs catalog pmol/l (factor 1000). Free-fraction LOINC used.

renin.note: NČLP only has renin mass concentration [ng/l]; catalog unit mU/l has no fixed conversion. Only a Plasma mass LOINC exists, so none for the serum item. No plasma renin activity item in NČLP.
renin.ambiguous: Direct renin is reported in mU/l (arbitrary units) or ng/l (mass), different quantities; NČLP has only the mass item.

rustovy_hormon.note: NČLP only has STH in mU/l (arb. subst. conc.); catalog µg/l via fixed factor 0.3333. Mass LOINC would be 2963-7.
rustovy_hormon.ambiguous: Growth hormone is reported in µg/l (mass) or mU/l (units), different LOINC codes (2963-7 vs 33858-2).

vapnik.ambiguous: Catalog unit conversion mixes molar and mass units, which are different LOINC codes (mass variant: 17861-6; NCLP has no mass item).

horcik.ambiguous: Catalog unit conversion mixes molar and mass units, which are different LOINC codes (mass variant: 19123-9; NCLP has no mass item).

horcik_ery.note: No NCLP item for magnesium in erythrocytes (searched Mg/magnesium/erytrocyty/ICT).

fosfor.ambiguous: Catalog unit conversion mixes molar and mass units, which are different LOINC codes (mass variant: 2777-1; NCLP has no mass item).

bikarbonat.note: NCLP has no method-independent (*) blood bicarbonate item; 05014 'HCO3 aktualni (P)' exists only with procedure CALC (Vypocet).
bikarbonat.ambiguous: Actual vs standard bicarbonate (05015) and measured total CO2 (01466, LOINC 2028-9) are separate items labs may print under this name.

selen.ambiguous: Catalog converts from ug/l; NCLP has separate mass items 55036 (S)/55034 (P), LOINC 5724-0.

cholesterol.ambiguous: Catalog unit conversion mixes molar and mass units, which are different LOINC codes (mass variant: 2093-3; NCLP has no mass item).

triacylglyceroly.ambiguous: Catalog unit conversion mixes molar and mass units, which are different LOINC codes (mass variant: 2571-8; NCLP has no mass item).

hdl.ambiguous: Catalog unit conversion mixes molar and mass units, which are different LOINC codes (mass variant: 2085-9; NCLP has no mass item).

ldl.ambiguous: A plain 'LDL cholesterol' may be measured or calculated; the names that say výpočet/Friedewald are ldl_vypocet (round 7). mg/dl is a mass variant.

aip.note: Computed index log(TAG/HDL); no NCLP item.

apolipoprotein_b.ambiguous: NCLP has both 'Apolipoprotein B' (00762/00760) and 'Apolipoprotein B100' (00766/00764); both plausible for this entry.

pomer_apob_apoa1.note: Computed ratio ApoB/ApoA-I; no NCLP item.

pomer_ldl_hdl.note: Computed ratio LDL/HDL; no NCLP item.

remnantni_cholesterol.note: Computed value (total - HDL - LDL); no NCLP item.

vldl.note: Usually computed (TAG/2.2); no NCLP item for VLDL cholesterol.

zelezo.ambiguous: Catalog unit conversion mixes molar and mass units, which are different LOINC codes (mass variant: 2498-4; NCLP has no mass item).

vk_fe_volna.note: No NCLP item for unsaturated (free) iron-binding capacity (UIBC); only total binding capacity 02988/02986.

saturace_trf.note: Calculated NČLP item "Transferin saturovaný železem" (system Transferin celkový S/P), fraction [1] vs catalog %.

str.ambiguous: NCLP also has molar sTfR items 11602 (S)/11600 (P) in nmol/l.

vitamin_b12.ambiguous: Catalog converts from ng/l; NCLP has separate mass items 03695 (S)/03691 (P), LOINC 2132-9.

aktivni_b12.note: LOINC 72160-5 is Serum-only (no SerPl code exists); left out for the P item.

kyselina_listova_ery.note: NCLP 06971 'Folat (ICT(erytrocyty))' is in umol/l; catalog uses nmol/l (x1000).
kyselina_listova_ery.ambiguous: Some labs report whole-blood folate (NCLP 07322 Folat (B), nmol/l) under this name instead.

kyselina_listova.ambiguous: Catalog converts from ng/ml; NCLP has separate mass items 03714 (S)/03710 (P), LOINC 2284-8.

vitamin_d.ambiguous: Catalog converts from ng/ml; mass variant is LOINC 62292-8 (NCLP has no mass item).

mma.note: NCLP items are in umol/l; catalog uses nmol/l (x1000).

omega3_index.note: No NCLP item for omega-3 index (EPA+DHA in erythrocyte membranes).

vitamin_b1.ambiguous: Labs usually measure thiamine diphosphate (LOINC 74444-1) while the NCLP item is generic 'Vitamin B1 (B)'.

vitamin_b6.note: NCLP items are named 'Vitamin B6'; LOINC chosen for pyridoxal phosphate as per catalog.
vitamin_b6.ambiguous: Whole-blood (B) and serum/plasma PLP are different quantities with different reference ranges.

vitamin_d_1_25.ambiguous: Catalog converts from pg/ml; mass variant is LOINC 1649-3 (NCLP has no mass item).

vitamin_e.note: NCLP item is 'Tokoferol'; LOINC chosen for alpha-tocopherol per catalog.

vitamin_k.note: No NCLP item for vitamin K1/phylloquinone.

bnp.note: NCLP has only a plasma mass item; a molar item 08130 (pmol/l) also exists.

crp_hs.note: NCLP has no separate hs-CRP item; linked the general CRP items. LOINC is the high-sensitivity method code.

troponin_t.ambiguous: NCLP has both 'Troponin T ultrasenzitivni' (S/P, ng/l) and generic 'Troponin T' (S/P/B) items; hs vs conventional are different LOINC codes.

elfo_albumin.note: NCLP items are mass fraction [1]; catalog uses % (x100).

elfo_alfa1.note: NCLP items are mass fraction [1]; catalog uses % (x100).
elfo_alfa1.ambiguous: Labs may also print absolute alpha-1-globulin in g/l (NCLP 00086/00059).

elfo_alfa2.note: NČLP item is a mass fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

elfo_beta.note: NČLP item is a mass fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

elfo_beta1.note: NČLP item is a mass fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

elfo_beta2.note: NČLP item is a mass fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

elfo_gama.note: NČLP item is a mass fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

pomer_kappa_lambda.note: Computed ratio of free light chains; no NČLP item after search (kappa, lambda, FLC, poměr). Auto-candidate 07034 is a B-cell count, unrelated. LOINC would be 104546-7 (SerPl mass ratio) but there is no NČLP key to attach it to.

anti_tg.note: Auto-candidates 57594/57592 'Anti-TG IgG' are anti-THYMOglobulin (English name), excluded. IgG LOINC 56635-6 is Serum-only (no method-free SerPl code).
anti_tg.ambiguous: NČLP has both generic Anti-tyreoglobulin (09477/08458) and Anti-tyreoglobulin IgG (14678/14677) items in kU/l; labs may use either.

anti_tpo.note: NČLP names anti-TPO 'Anti-mikrosomy IgG' (English 'Anti-TPO, IgG'). Generic 'Anti-mikrosomy' 09480/08461 (thyroid microsome Ab, kU/l; LOINC would be 8099-4) not linked.
anti_tpo.ambiguous: NČLP also has generic thyroid microsomal antibodies (09480/08461, kU/l) that some labs may use for anti-TPO.

trak.note: LOINC 5385-0 is Serum-only (no method-free SerPl code). TSI (stimulating antibodies) is a separate NČLP item 18016/18014.
trak.ambiguous: Synonyms include TSI (stimulating TSH-receptor antibodies), which NČLP codes separately (18016/18014) from total TRAK (08035/08034).

osteokalcin.note: NČLP also has molar items 08918/08915 (nmol/l), not linked.

anti_gad.note: LOINC 13926-1 is GAD65 Ab in Serum (no method-free SerPl code).
anti_gad.ambiguous: NČLP has generic Anti-GAD (08411/08409) and Anti-GAD65 IgG (59021/59018) items, both kU/l.

anti_ia2.note: LOINC: IA-2 = Islet cell 512 Ab; 31209-0 is Serum-only.

ctx.note: Telopeptid kolagenu CTx-beta mass items (ng/l). NČLP also has molar items 12611/58164 (pmol/l), not linked.

hba1c.note: NČLP 'Hemoglobin A1c (DOF)' substance fraction [mmol/mol]; LOINC 59261-8 is the IFCC-protocol HbA1c code (NGSP % would be 4548-4).

hematokrit.note: NČLP 'Erytrocyty (hematokrit)' volume fraction [1]. No method-free LOINC for blood exists; 4544-3 (automated count) is the standard analyzer code.

rdw.note: NČLP RDW is relative SD [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

trombokrit.note: NČLP unit is volume fraction [10^-3] (= ml/l); catalog canonical is fraction [1] (x1000 to get the NČLP value).

pdw.note: Linked PDW-SD (fl) matching catalog unit; LOINC 32207-3 is by automated count.
pdw.ambiguous: Synonym 'PDW' may be printed as relative width in % (NČLP 04745, LOINC 51631-0) instead of PDW-SD in fl.

retikulocyty.note: NČLP num. fraction of erythrocytes [1], same as catalog canonical unit.

retik_index.note: Computed reticulocyte (production) index; no NČLP item after search (index, produkční, retikulocyt). LOINC 31111-8 exists but there is no NČLP key to attach it to.

cohb.note: NČLP 'Karbonylhemoglobin' substance fraction of Hb [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100. NČLP 01468 (mmol/l) not linked.

ig.note: NČLP num. fraction of leukocytes [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

ipf.note: NČLP num. fraction of platelets [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100. Method-free LOINC 51633-6 is DISCOURAGED, so the automated-count code is used.

ipf_abs.note: Method-free LOINC 51632-8 is DISCOURAGED, so the automated-count code is used.

irf.note: NČLP 'Retikulocyty (IRFMH)' = medium+high fluorescence fraction of reticulocytes (= Sysmex IRF), fraction [1]; catalog % = x100. High-only IRFH is 14057.

methb.note: NČLP substance fraction of Hb [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

nrbc.note: NČLP 'Normoblasty (B; num. podíl [1])'; catalog % = fraction x 100. LOINC 19048-8 = NRBC per 100 leukocytes.
nrbc.ambiguous: NRBC % may be per 100 leukocytes (usual, LOINC 19048-8) or per erythrocytes (26461-4); the NČLP item does not state the reference population.

rdw_sd.note: LOINC 21000-5 is by automated count (method-free 30384-2 is deprecated).

ret_he.note: NČLP 'Hemoglobin (MCHR)' in reticulocytes [pg] covers RET-He / CHr.

neutrofily.note: NČLP fractions [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100. Split 2026-10-21 (docs/plans/model-loop.md round 7). 'Granulocyty' moved to granulocyty.
neutrofily.ambiguous: Entry mixes total neutrophils (03620) and segmented neutrophils (03630) via synonyms; these are different NČLP items.

lymfocyty.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

monocyty.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

eosinofily.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

basofily.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

neutrofily_abs.ambiguous: Synonyms include 'Neutrofilní segmenty - absolutní' (segmented only), which is not exactly total neutrophils. ('Gra granulocyty' moved to granulocyty_abs, round 7.)

atypicke_lymfocyty.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100. NČLP item is 'Lymfocyty susp. reaktivní' (reactive = atypical lymphocytes); LOINC 'Variant lymphocytes'.

blasty.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

metamyelocyty.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

myelocyty.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

neutrofilni_tyce.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

plazmaticke_bunky.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

promyelocyty.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

cd3.note: No NČLP item for this %-of-lymphocytes value (NČLP has only absolute counts [10^9/l] for CD subsets).

cd4.note: No NČLP item for this %-of-lymphocytes value (NČLP has only absolute counts [10^9/l] for CD subsets).

cd4_abs.note: 06609 = CD3+/CD4+ (helper T, LOINC 24467-3); 06645 = all CD4+ cells (its LOINC 8127-3 is deprecated, so none given).
cd4_abs.ambiguous: Labs report either CD3+CD4+ (helper T) or plain CD4+ counts; these are different NČLP items.

cd8.note: No NČLP item for this %-of-lymphocytes value (NČLP has only absolute counts [10^9/l] for CD subsets).

cd8_abs.note: 06627 = CD3+/CD8+ (LOINC 14135-8); 06876 = all CD8+ cells (its LOINC 8137-2 is deprecated, so none given).
cd8_abs.ambiguous: Labs report either CD3+CD8+ (cytotoxic T) or plain CD8+ counts; these are different NČLP items.

cd19.note: No NČLP item for this %-of-lymphocytes value (NČLP has only absolute counts [10^9/l] for CD subsets).

nk_bunky.note: No NČLP item for this %-of-lymphocytes value (NČLP has only absolute counts [10^9/l] for CD subsets).

pomer_cd4_cd8.note: Computed ratio, not in NČLP. Auto candidate 06723 'Buňky CD4+/CD8+' is a count of double-positive cells, not the ratio.

ana.note: Linked the ANA IgG titre items (IIF titre, unitless). NČLP also has quantitative ANA IgG in kU/l (14604 S / 14603 P) and arb. units (51709/51707). Only a Serum-only titre LOINC exists; given to S only.
ana.ambiguous: ANA can be reported as an IIF titre, as a screen index/positivity, or in kU/l (different NČLP items).

anca.note: Generic 'ANCA IgG (arb. konc.)' items (not marked as in the main NČLP table). Separate NČLP items exist for C-ANCA/P-ANCA titres (00662/00659, 00668/00665). Only a Serum-only LOINC; given to S only.
anca.ambiguous: ANCA IIF screen may be reported as a generic result or split into c-ANCA/p-ANCA titres (different NČLP items).

anti_beta2gp1_igg.note: The SerPl LOINC is 'by Immunoassay' (the standard method).

anti_beta2gp1_igm.note: The SerPl LOINC is 'by Immunoassay' (the standard method).

anti_dgp_iga.note: Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

anti_dgp_igg.note: Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

anti_ema_iga.note: Presence items (positive/negative). Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

anti_gliadin_iga.note: Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

anti_ttg_iga.note: Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

aslo.note: NČLP items are not marked as in the main table but are the only ASLO items; kU/l = IU/ml.

ena_screen.note: Presence items. NČLP also has relative optical density items 59549 S / 59547 P. Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.
ena_screen.ambiguous: ENA screen may be reported qualitatively (presence) or as an index/OD ratio (different NČLP items).

igg1.note: Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

igg2.note: Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

igg3.note: Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

igg4.note: Only a Serum-only LOINC exists; given to the S item only.

lupus_antikoagulans.note: No NČLP item for a lupus anticoagulant result/ratio. NČLP only has the underlying clotting times in seconds (RVVT 07874, APTT LA 09466) and a descriptive item 56799 'Popis a interpretace - LA'.
lupus_antikoagulans.ambiguous: Entry mixes LA screening result, dRVVT screen and normalized LA ratio, which are different quantities.

anti_xa.note: 16253 = LMWH anti-Xa activity, 16316 = unfractionated heparin anti-Xa activity (kU/l = IU/ml). Not marked as in the main NČLP table.
anti_xa.ambiguous: Entry mixes anti-Xa calibrated for LMWH and for UFH, which are different NČLP items/LOINC codes.

antitrombin.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100. 16163 = anti-IIa based activity, 16165 = anti-Xa based activity; both chromogenic, LOINC 27811-9.
antitrombin.ambiguous: NČLP has two equally plausible activity items (anti-IIa vs anti-Xa based); antigen item 16158 also exists.

aptt.note: Plasma APTT. Whole-blood/POCT item 07728 not linked.

aptt_pomer.note: Calculated NČLP item "APTT poměr" (P; rel. čas).

d_dimery.note: Plasma items; NČLP unit mg/l (catalog µg/l, x1000). 16432 = FEU (LOINC 48065-7); 03492 = plain D-dimer (FEU/DDU unspecified, no LOINC given). DDU names and conversions moved to d_dimery_ddu (round 7).

faktor_viii.note: NČLP item is a fraction [1]; catalog % = fraction x 100.

inr.note: NČLP has no * (method-independent) item for plasma INR; linked the only item PT INR (P; rel. čas [1]) whose procedure is CALC (Výpočet). A POCT whole-blood item 55960 (B) also exists, not linked.

protein_c.note: NČLP gives a fraction [1] (relativní arb. aktivita), catalog uses % (x100). No LOINC: all LOINC protein C activity codes carry a method (27819-2 coagulation, 27818-4 chromogenic). Antigen item 16275 not linked.

protein_s.note: NČLP fraction [1] vs catalog % (x100). 16279 = activity, 16282 = free antigen (LOINC 27821-8, immunoassay implied by antigen). No LOINC for activity (27822-6 is coagulation-method specific).
protein_s.ambiguous: Synonyms mix Protein S activity and free Protein S antigen, which are different NČLP items (16279 vs 16282); total antigen 16277 also exists.

pt_pomer.note: NČLP has no * item for PT ratio; linked PT poměr (P; rel. čas [1]) with procedure CALC (Výpočet).

quick.note: No * item; linked PT kalibrovaný (P; relativní arb. aktivita [1], procedure CALC) = Quick activity; NČLP fraction [1] vs catalog % (x100). No confident LOINC for Quick % (5894-1 is PT actual/normal time ratio).

vwf_aktivita.note: NČLP fraction [1] vs catalog % (x100). 54250 = vWF activity (vWF:Ac / GPIbM), 16327 = ristocetin cofactor function (vWF:RCo). LOINC 68324-3 (vWf:Ac, immunoassay) for 54250; RCo LOINC codes are method-specific (6014-5 aggregometry, 107378-2 turbidimetry), left out.
vwf_aktivita.ambiguous: Synonyms mix vWF:RCo (16327) and vWF:Ac/GPIbM activity (54250), separate NČLP items; collagen-binding 16323 also exists.

vwf_antigen.note: NČLP fraction [1] vs catalog % (x100). LOINC 27816-8 is by immunoassay (implied for an antigen).

krevni_skupina.note: Krevní skupina AB0 RhD kompletní (B; přítomnost). Newborn (05164) and verification (56782) variants not linked.

nat.note: 14190/14187 = Screening protilátek - NAT (arb. konc. [arb.j.]); 05225/05222 = generic antibody screening (přítomnost [-], LOINC 890-4). No LOINC for the NAT arb.c. items (IAT LOINC 50959-6 is a presence code).
nat.ambiguous: NAT result maps to two NČLP item kinds: IAT-specific screening as arb. concentration (14190/14187) vs generic antibody screen presence (05225/05222).

pat.note: PAT - průkaz senzibilizace ery (Erytrocyty(B); přítomnost). IgG/C3 sub-specific PAT items (56763-56777) not linked.

rh_faktor.note: Rh D (Erytrocyty(B); přítomnost). Weak D item 14234 not linked.

afp.note: Mass items (µg/l). NČLP also has kU/l items 59613 (S) / 59611 (P).
afp.ambiguous: Catalog converts kU/l and IU/ml into µg/l, but NČLP has separate mass (µg/l) and arbitrary-substance (kU/l) items for AFP.

cyfra_21_1.note: LOINC 25390-6 = Cytokeratin 19 [Mass/volume] SerPl (CYFRA 21-1 is a CK19 fragment).

pomer_fpsa_psa.note: Calculated NČLP item "PSA - podíl volné frakce", fraction [1] vs catalog %.

roma.note: Computed index (HE4 + CA125 + menopausal status); not in NČLP after searching ROMA/ovarian.

s100.note: Linked S100B items. LOINC 47275-3 is Serum-only (no SerPl code exists), attached to the S item only.

anti_borrelia_igg_wb.note: Linked method-independent Anti-Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato IgG (arb. konc. [arb.j.]); immunoblot method variants are 53335/53332. Similar items exist for B. burgdorferi (51837/51834) and Borrelia species (55441/55438). No LOINC for blot result.
anti_borrelia_igg_wb.ambiguous: Several Borrelia IgG components fit (B. burgdorferi s.l., B. burgdorferi, Borrelia species).

anti_borrelia_igm_wb.note: Linked method-independent Anti-Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato IgM (arb. konc. [arb.j.]); immunoblot method variants are 53341/53338. Similar items exist for B. burgdorferi (51849/51846) and Borrelia species (55453/55450). No LOINC for blot result.
